# Workstation Comparison Matrix

| Attribute     | Aurora 14                  | Summit X15                 | Vantage Pro 16             |
|---------------|----------------------------|----------------------------|----------------------------|
| CPU           | Helix H9 AI, 16 cores      | Helix H7 AI, 12 cores      | Corvex X12, 14 cores       |
| GPU           | Vireo V8000 Pro, 16 GB     | Vireo V6000, 8 GB          | Vireo V9000, 24 GB         |
| Max Memory    | 128 GB (user-upgradeable)  | 96 GB                      | 64 GB (soldered)           |
| Max Storage   | 4 TB NVMe                  | not stated                 | 2 TB                       |
| Display       | 14-inch OLED, 2880x1800, 120 Hz | 15.6-inch OLED, 3840x2400, 60 Hz | 16-inch IPS, 2560x1600, 165 Hz |
| Weight        | 1.65 kg                    | 1.95 kg                    | 2.30 kg                    |
| Battery       | 86 Wh                      | not stated                 | 99 Wh                      |
| Ports         | 2x Thunderbolt 5, 1x USB-A, HDMI 2.1, SD card reader | 2x Thunderbolt 4, 1x USB-A, HDMI 2.1 | not stated |

## Aurora 14 Differentiators

1. **Lightest weight in the lineup at 1.65 kg** — Aurora 14 is 0.30 kg lighter than Summit X15 and 0.65 kg lighter than Vantage Pro 16, making it the most portable option.

2. **Highest memory capacity and user-upgradeable** — Aurora 14 supports up to 128 GB of RAM and is user-upgradeable, compared to Summit X15's 96 GB and Vantage Pro 16's soldered 64 GB limit.

3. **Fastest connectivity with Thunderbolt 5 and SD card reader** — Aurora 14 includes two Thunderbolt 5 ports (newer than Summit X15's Thunderbolt 4) and an SD card reader, offering superior I/O options.
